title: FV Viewpoint Records
description: Root-level viewpoint.json array. Identifies observers/viewpoints and records the initial viewpoint state without assuming camera geometry.

id.description: Stable typed viewpoint identifier. VP-DEFAULT is reserved for virtual legacy compatibility and must not be authored as a new viewpoint.

type.description: Generic observer kind, e.g. camera, human, robot, drone, telescope, unknown.

status.description: How much of the initial viewpoint state is supported by the source.

position.description: Qualitative or source-supported initial observer position; do not invent coordinates.

orientation.description: Qualitative or source-supported initial observer orientation.

description.description: Concise description of where/how the view is initially situated.

basis.description: Evidence or source basis for the initial-state description.

sensor.description: Optional source-supported sensor/device metadata; do not infer missing properties.
